verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents calendar-based auto-join, letting Fred 'autojoin your calendar meetings', and automatic recording of Google Meet calls. A 'Rules Engine' gives admins automation workflows, but the evidence describes it only as controlling 'meeting access and privacy', not which meeting types get captured. Missing for 10: explicit Google and Outlook calendar connection docs, documented per-meeting-type auto-capture rules (e.g., internal vs external, by organizer or title), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
